evidence: Drops Boost.Test from CMake, depends (depends/packages/boost.mk), Guix, and vcpkg configurations.
rationale: Removing Boost.Test simplifies dependency configurations across CMake, depends, and Guix. The PR eliminates build-system packaging overhead and tooling complications (such as IWYU and clang-tidy support), representing worthwhile build-system simplification without addressing an active release or platform failure.
